one_liner: Email and SMS marketing platform with rich customer data APIs

evidence.claim: Klaviyo supports private API key auth, OAuth, and a public key for client-side endpoints
evidence.quote: Klaviyo provides 3 methods of authentication including private key authentication and OAuth (used to call server-side APIs) and public key authentication (used to call client-side APIs).

evidence.claim: Private API keys are self-serve, created in account Settings with a custom Authorization header
A free Klaviyo account can be created and used to obtain API credentials
evidence.quote: If you don't already have a Klaviyo account, you can sign up for a free account on the Klaviyo website.

evidence.claim: Klaviyo's own developer docs document an official MCP server
evidence.quote: The Klaviyo Model Context Protocol (MCP) server seamlessly integrates with Klaviyo's APIs, enabling AI clients to interact with your Klaviyo data.

evidence.claim: The API surface is large, spanning profiles, lists, campaigns, events and more
evidence.quote: The Klaviyo MCP Server provides over 34 tools for interacting with Klaviyo's API endpoints.

notes: Vendor ships an official MCP server (developers.klaviyo.com). OAuth is required only for App Marketplace listing; private keys work immediately for server-side /api endpoints. API calls require a dated 'revision' header (e.g., revision: 2024-10-15), a versioning gotcha. Client-side /client endpoints use the public 6-character company ID only. Managing API keys requires Owner, Admin, or Manager role within the account.
